defmodule FileService.AccessControl do
  @moduledoc "Role-based access control for file operations"

  @roles %{
    admin: [:read, :write, :delete, :list],
    editor: [:read, :write, :list],
    viewer: [:read, :list]
  }

  def check_permission(user, action) do
    role = safe_to_role_atom(user.role)
    permissions = Map.get(@roles, role, [])
    if action in permissions, do: :ok, else: {:error, :forbidden}
  end

  # Fail closed: if the role string is not a known, pre-existing atom,
  # treat it as an invalid role rather than raising ArgumentError.
  defp safe_to_role_atom(role) when is_atom(role), do: role

  defp safe_to_role_atom(role) when is_binary(role) do
    try do
      String.to_existing_atom(role)
    rescue
      ArgumentError -> :__invalid_role__
    end
  end

  defp safe_to_role_atom(_), do: :__invalid_role__
end

defmodule FileService.PathValidator do
  @moduledoc "Validates and resolves file paths within the sandbox"

  @base_dir "/var/fileservice/data"

  def base_dir, do: @base_dir

  def validate_path(relative_path) do
    # Reject obvious traversal attempts
    if String.contains?(relative_path, "..") do
      {:error, :invalid_path}
    else
      {:ok, Path.join(@base_dir, relative_path)}
    end
  end

  def ensure_within_sandbox(resolved_path) do
    # Check that the canonical path starts with our base directory
    canonical = resolve_canonical(resolved_path)
    if String.starts_with?(canonical, @base_dir) do
      {:ok, canonical}
    else
      {:error, :path_escape}
    end
  end

  defp resolve_canonical(path) do
    # Resolve the full path including the final component
    # to detect symlinks at any level
    case File.stat(path) do
      {:ok, %File.Stat{type: :directory}} ->
        resolve_real_path(path)
      {:ok, %File.Stat{}} ->
        resolve_real_path(path)
      {:error, :enoent} ->
        # File doesn't exist yet; resolve parent and append basename
        parent = Path.dirname(path)
        basename = Path.basename(path)
        real_parent = resolve_real_path(parent)
        Path.join(real_parent, basename)
      _ ->
        path
    end
  end

  defp resolve_real_path(path) do
    # Use the system's realpath to fully resolve all symlinks
    case System.cmd("realpath", ["-e", path], stderr_to_stdout: true) do
      {resolved, 0} ->
        String.trim(resolved)
      _ ->
        # Fallback: walk components manually
        components = Path.split(path)
        Enum.reduce(components, "/", fn component, acc ->
          current = Path.join(acc, component)
          case File.read_link(current) do
            {:ok, target} ->
              resolved = if Path.type(target) == :absolute do
                target
              else
                Path.join(acc, target)
              end
              # Recursively resolve in case of chained symlinks
              resolve_real_path(resolved)
            {:error, _} ->
              current
          end
        end)
    end
  end
end

defmodule FileService.Processor do
  @moduledoc "Main file processing service"

  alias FileService.AccessControl
  alias FileService.PathValidator

  def read_file(user, relative_path) do
    with :ok <- AccessControl.check_permission(user, :read),
         {:ok, full_path} <- PathValidator.validate_path(relative_path),
         {:ok, safe_path} <- PathValidator.ensure_within_sandbox(full_path) do
      # Re-verify after resolution to prevent TOCTOU
      final_check = verify_no_symlink_escape(safe_path)
      case final_check do
        :ok -> File.read(safe_path)
        error -> error
      end
    end
  end

  def write_file(user, relative_path, content) do
    with :ok <- AccessControl.check_permission(user, :write),
         {:ok, full_path} <- PathValidator.validate_path(relative_path),
         {:ok, safe_path} <- PathValidator.ensure_within_sandbox(full_path) do
      final_check = verify_no_symlink_escape(safe_path)
      case final_check do
        :ok -> File.write(safe_path, content)
        error -> error
      end
    end
  end

  def list_files(user, relative_path) do
    with :ok <- AccessControl.check_permission(user, :list),
         {:ok, full_path} <- PathValidator.validate_path(relative_path),
         {:ok, safe_path} <- PathValidator.ensure_within_sandbox(full_path) do
      final_check = verify_no_symlink_escape(safe_path)
      case final_check do
        :ok -> File.ls(safe_path)
        error -> error
      end
    end
  end

  def delete_file(user, relative_path) do
    with :ok <- AccessControl.check_permission(user, :delete),
         {:ok, full_path} <- PathValidator.validate_path(relative_path),
         {:ok, safe_path} <- PathValidator.ensure_within_sandbox(full_path) do
      final_check = verify_no_symlink_escape(safe_path)
      case final_check do
        :ok -> File.rm(safe_path)
        error -> error
      end
    end
  end

  defp verify_no_symlink_escape(path) do
    # Final lstat check: if the target is a symlink, verify its real target
    case File.lstat(path) do
      {:ok, %File.Stat{type: :symlink}} ->
        case File.read_link(path) do
          {:ok, target} ->
            abs_target = if Path.type(target) == :absolute do
              target
            else
              Path.join(Path.dirname(path), target)
            end
            base = PathValidator.base_dir()
            case System.cmd("realpath", ["-e", abs_target], stderr_to_stdout: true) do
              {resolved, 0} ->
                if String.starts_with?(String.trim(resolved), base) do
                  :ok
                else
                  {:error, :symlink_escape}
                end
              _ ->
                {:error, :symlink_escape}
            end
          _ ->
            {:error, :symlink_escape}
        end
      {:ok, _} -> :ok
      {:error, :enoent} -> :ok  # File doesn't exist yet (write case)
      _ -> {:error, :invalid_path}
    end
  end
end
